note: G2 zombie AI (game balance, not real-world data). Zombies only pursue the closest hostile and strike it in melee: no weapon, no grenades, no cover. EN1: 'types' are the enemy types on the zombie brain and pack code; [0] is the plain zombie (unchanged), AI type 'Zombies + heavies' picks a type per slot by 'weight'. Per type: model (content/characters/<model>.glb, rest pose scaled to height_m; swap it here; its bones carry the game's joint names: Hips, Spine2, Neck, Head, Left/RightArm, ForeArm, Hand, UpLeg, Leg, Foot), fallback_scale / fallback_lean_deg (used on the zombie model and clips when the model or its walk clip is missing), scale (drawn and hit at that size), lean_deg (forward tilt), tint, hp, damage per blow, reach_m (the blow lands within it), lunge_m (a strike may start this far out and closes the gap during the wind-up), cooldown_s, attack_rate (the attack clip plays at this rate; the blow lands at its swing frame, windup_s is the fallback without clips), walk_mps / run_mps (run when the target is within run_within_m), weight (share in a horde), hit_zone_scale (hit capsule radii x, on top of the body size scale x height_m / 1.85: the spider is low, so its zones are widened), knockback_mps (shove on the player), stagger_min_damage / stagger_s (only a single hit of at least this flinches it and stops it that long), clips. The zombie's run_mps sits between the jog and the sprint of content/settings/movement.json. The model is content/characters/zombie.glb (RINONO, CC-BY-4.0, docs/credits.md). models (optional): variants of the type, one per AI of it in turn (the plain zombie: zombie, zombie_necro, zombie_deadman, the last two wearing its clips retargeted by tools/bake_ai_characters.py).glb (the SCP-096 remodel, converted from the user-supplied FBX with its clips by tools/enemies/convert_enemy_glb.py; weight 0: AI type Creatures only, never in the Zombies + heavies mix; its death is a synthesized topple). Brute = content/characters/troll.glb, stalker = content/characters/spider.glb (EN1, converted from the user-supplied FBX with all clips; docs/credits.md). EN2: height_m is the rest (T-pose) height the model is scaled to: the troll's 2.78 stands about 2.4 m in its idle, the spider's 1.55 gives a back about 1.3 m high and legs about 2.3 m across / 2.6 to 3.3 m front to back. explosive_mult: every blast deals that many times its damage to the type; capsule_height_m / capsule_radius_m: its own physics capsule (the navmesh stays the soldier's). clips: damage and death take a list (one per hit / death), attack picks one at random per strike and the blow lands at that clip's swing frame; 'unused' names the takes no game state plays. EN4: climb_m: the type takes the heavies-only climb links (trench lips, crater rims, low walls up to the nav pass's heavyClimbMax_m, content/ai/navigation.json links; default 2.2 m) and, stuck for 2 s, climbs a lip up to climb_m within 3 m; step_gap_m: it also takes the heavies-only gap links (heavyGapMax_m, default 2.8 m: the spider steps over narrow trenches); clips.climb plays over a climb (none: the walk clip).

pack.note: PF1 hordes: with more than min_zombies alive, zombies run in packs of up to `size`. Only the leader picks a target and requests paths; followers slide along the navmesh to a wedge slot slot_spacing_m apart behind it (separation within separation_m, alignment to the leader's velocity), catch up at catch_up x speed while the leader keeps leader_pace, break off to strike any hostile within break_off_m, and path on their own beyond lost_m. A packless zombie joins the nearest pack leader within join_m.

lod.note: PF1: clips are sampled at anim_hz_near beyond anim_near_m from the camera and at anim_hz_far beyond anim_far_m; a pack follower walking beyond share_pose_m wears its leader's pose and skinned mesh.

clips.unused: Troll_Block, Troll_Block_Lower, Troll_BlockReaction, Troll_BlockReaction_Optimal, Troll_IdleToBlock (no blocking), Troll_MoveLeft/Right(Short) (no strafing), Troll_AttackBackHand/ForeHand_Enter and _Idle (wind-up and hold pieces of the _Damage swings)

Spider_Block*, Spider_BlockReaction, Spider_Block_Optimal_Reaction (no blocking), Spider_Critter_WalkBack, Spider_MoveLeft/Right(_Short) (no strafing), Spider_StunnedLoop, Spider_Attack_Leftt/Right_Enter/Loop/Exit (a held claw-attack sequence)

C.096_AChrge.F, C.096_AGate.F, C.096_AJumpFall.F, C.096_DIdle.F, C.096_Dstd.F, C.096_Dtry1.F, the other ARun / DWlk directions (no strafing); death is synthesized by tools/enemies/convert_enemy_glb.py (the model has none)
